title.en: REL-TASK-047 — Build Ybus from network data
title.ru: REL-TASK-047 — Построение Ybus по данным сети

instructions.en: Use the public inputs to produce the required JSON answer. The evaluator checks feasibility and exact deterministic surrogate consistency.
instructions.ru: Используйте опубликованные входные данные и сформируйте требуемый JSON-ответ. Оцениватель проверяет допустимость и точное соответствие детерминированному суррогату.

calculation_spec.rule: For a two-bus line, off-diagonal entries are -series_admittance; diagonal entries are series_admittance + shunt_admittance_per_bus.

hard_constraints: Submission must contain the expected answer field with the correct JSON type.
Numerical values must match the deterministic public surrogate within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted structured answer satisfies all hard constraints.
